category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The first four tokens are all traditionally recognized as part of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Parthenon, while an iconic ancient structure, is not included in this traditional list.

The first four phrases use the word 'break' to signify violating, ending, or interrupting something. 'Break a leg' is an idiom meaning 'good luck' and does not imply a literal or figurative disruption.
